notes.title: Release this April! 🗓️⛳
notes.notes:
I’m so grateful for every single one of you who’s joined me on this journey. Your support means the world and keeps me motivated to make this game the best it can be. ❤️

I’m excited to officially announce that the game will be released this April! 🗓️⛳ Mark your calendars, because the adventure is just around the corner!

Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and maybe even some surprises along the way. 😉

Thank you all for being here – let’s keep growing together! 🚀

notes.title: Another Demo Update ⛳
notes.notes:
Hello golfers!

Listen, I've updated the DEMO for you once again! Some big changes and some small ones. I hope you like it ⛳

3 levels available
Revamped the third level
Performance improvements
Difficulty levels!
Thanks for playing :) Feel free to let me know what you like or don't like - I'll keep working on it!

Take care!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
⛳️ Big News for Really Simple Golf ⛳️
[b]
Hey everyone![/b]

Just wanted to give you a quick update on all the hard work going on behind the scenes. 

[b]*Performance Upgrade! *[/b]

I've been optimizing the game to make sure it runs smooth as butter. This means a more enjoyable experience for everyone, no matter your spec.

[b]*New Levels!*[/b]

Keep making new levels for full version, it takes some time because I want every level to be different so you can have varied experience.

Each level will not only boast different aesthetics but also introduce fresh obstacles and innovative ways to reach the hole. Get ready to think strategically and unleash your inner golfing genius!

I can't wait to share more details about these exciting new levels soon. In the meantime, keep your eyes peeled for more updates!

[b]Let me know in the comments what kind of crazy golf challenges you'd love to see! [/b]

notes.title: Demo Update 30.04.2024
notes.notes:
Hi golfers!

Thank you so much for playing Really Simple Golf. I hope you had a great time :)
I'm making a small update based on your feedback about the game. Here's the list:

[list]
- Fixing a bug where the ball would get stuck if it was hit too lightly
- Lowering the water sounds
- Lowering the music volume in the menu
[/list]

It's thanks to you and your feedback that I can improve this game. Feel free to write more :)
